seo.title: About the Studio
seo.description: Trace Studio is a digital studio that designs and builds websites, software products and business systems for US companies, with its engineering team in Cairo. Fixed price per phase, and the code is yours.

about.title: A trace is the mark that remains.
about.lead: An imprint, an effect — what is left after you have gone. It is also what we are hired to leave behind.
story: Most businesses need similar skeletons — accounts, orders, approvals, dashboards. What makes a system theirs is how it is shaped around their people, their tools and their workflow. That shaping is the mark it leaves.

Trace Studio builds the skeleton properly, then places the mark. We started because too many companies were paying for templates with their logo on top, or for developer hours with nobody accountable for the result.

We are a US-facing studio with our engineering team in Cairo. Our mark is three nuqtas — the Arabic word for the dots that turn one letter into another — a nod to where we build. You get senior engineers who overlap your working day, a fixed price per phase, and everything we build handed over to you.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: If you send us a message through the contact form we keep your name, company, email, phone number and what you wrote, so that we can reply. We do not collect anything else about you on this site.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We count page views and which contact buttons are pressed, in aggregate. We do not use advertising cookies and we do not build a profile of you.

sections.heading: Calls, email and messaging
sections.body: Booking a call, emailing us or messaging us is also governed by your own agreement with those providers. Your message reaches us the same way any customer message would.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep enquiries for as long as we are in conversation, and for a reasonable period afterwards in case you come back to us.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Ask us to delete your details at any time and we will, then confirm it in writing.

sections.heading: About this site
sections.body: This site describes the services Trace Studio offers. Nothing on it is a binding quote or a contract.

sections.heading: Project work
sections.body: Every project runs under a written agreement signed by both sides, covering scope, price, timing, ownership, confidentiality and support.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.body: On full payment for a phase, the source code, designs and documentation produced in that phase are yours.

sections.heading: Our work shown here
sections.body: Project pages describe work we did with the permission of the client. Client names and marks remain theirs. Concept pieces are labelled as such.

sections.heading: Accuracy
sections.body: We keep this site current, but we do not guarantee that every figure on it is up to date at the moment you read it.
